title: edgeforge, Fleet Health
description: Is the fleet safe right now? Audience: on-call, ops supervisors. Panels map to SLIs A1-A3 and B1-B5; see docs/06-sli-slo-and-telemetry.md.
__comment_color: Series are coloured by RING, not by rank. A filter that drops 'pilot' must
not repaint canary, colour follows the entity. Hexes are the validated
dark-surface categorical slots 1-3 (all-pairs CVD dE 9.4, normal-vision 20.9).
Threshold marks use the reserved status palette and always carry a text
label; status colour never carries meaning alone.

panels.title: Safety invariants, no error budget, a single breach freezes releases

panels.__comment: Stat tiles, not charts. A number that is either fine or not fine does not need a plot.
panels.title: Invariant breaches (24 h)
panels.description: A1 missed personnel + A2 signature failures + A3 envelope violations. Any non-zero value is an incident, not a trend.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
FleetHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ring_s in ($ring) or '$ring' == '$__all'
| summarize breaches = sum(safety_envelope_violations_d) + sum(signature_failures_d) + sum(missed_personnel_d)

panels.title: Perception availability (28 d)
panels.description: B1. Denominator is time OPERATING, not wall-clock; a parked robot is not unavailable. Objective 99.5%.

panels.title: Devices on intended bundle
panels.description: B5. Denominator is devices that were online and had the opportunity to converge, twin desired-state is convergent, so an offline robot is not a failure.

panels.title: Active rollbacks
panels.description: Rollbacks in flight right now. Non-zero is not automatically bad; it means the safety net fired and is working.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
RolloutEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and event_s == 'rollback'
| summarize active = countif(isnull(completed_t))

panels.__comment: One axis. Latency in ms only; the 45 ms budget is drawn as a threshold line, never as a second scale.
panels.title: Inference latency p99 by ring
panels.description: B2. The 45 ms line is the perception budget from the vehicle latency chain, not a warning level.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
FleetHealth_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ring_s in ($ring)
| summarize p99 = avg(inference_p99_ms_d) by ring_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Personnel detections per km vs ring baseline
panels.description: Rollback predicate. Deviation is watched in BOTH directions: a collapse means the model has gone blind, a spike means nuisance stops, and operators learn to override a model that cries wolf.

overrides.__comment: The +/-3 sigma band is drawn as a recessive filled area behind the series, not as a second axis.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let baseline = FleetHealth_CL
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1d))
  | summarize mu = avg(detections_personnel_per_km_d), sigma = stdev(detections_personnel_per_km_d) by ring_s;
FleetHealth_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ring_s in ($ring)
| summarize rate = avg(detections_personnel_per_km_d) by ring_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| join kind=leftouter baseline on ring_s
| extend baseline_high = mu + 3 * sigma, baseline_low = mu - 3 * sigma
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.__comment: Small multiples rather than eight series on one plot, past three series the all-pairs colour floors cannot be met, so we facet instead of cycling hues.
panels.title: Out-of-distribution rate by site
panels.description: Earliest available drift warning. A spike at ONE site is usually physical (new equipment, changed lighting, a re-muck); fleet-wide suggests the release. Runbook P2.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
FleetHealth_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and site_s == '$site'
| summarize ood = avg(ood_rate_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Thermal headroom by site (28 d)
panels.description: B4. Measured separately from latency on purpose, throttling makes every latency figure untrustworthy, and a thermal fault should not be able to masquerade as a model regression.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
FleetHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(28d)
| extend minutes = operating_seconds_d / 60.0
| summarize headroom = sum(minutes * (1.0 - throttled_pct_d / 100.0)) / sum(minutes) by site_s

panels.__comment: The table view is the accessibility fallback required whenever a status colour is doing work (identity is never colour-alone.
panels.title: SLO status) fleet group
panels.description: Generated by src/edgeforge/fleet/slo.py and written back as SloStatus_CL. This table is also the non-colour reading of every threshold on this page.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
SloStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h) and group_s == 'fleet'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by slo_id_s
| project id = slo_id_s, indicator = name_s, observed = observed_d, objective = objective_d, budget_remaining_pct = budget_remaining_pct_d, burn_rate = burn_rate_d, status = status_s
| order by id asc
